IshukoMaize Grading & Selling Platform

AI-powered quality grading that connects smallholder maize cooperatives with wholesale buyers

Product Overview
Core Features
Rebuild / Deploy Guide

Computer Vision Grading

A two-step OpenCV + YOLOv8 pipeline segments and classifies maize kernels into Grade A–D based on insect damage, discoloration, broken grains, and extraneous matter.

Trusted Marketplace

Cooperatives publish AI-verified batches; wholesale buyers browse, order, and schedule pickup within a 7-day window.

Secure Escrow Payments

Buyer funds sit in escrow until a 6-digit handshake code is exchanged at pickup, instantly releasing payment to the cooperative.

Full Stack

Flutter mobile app, Next.js/Tailwind admin dashboard, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, deployed on Vercel, Heroku, and GCP Cloud Run.
